body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 2 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An attack targets the creature from a source you detect, before rolling. Response (unopposed): Grant +1 to its targeted Defense against the attack.

surges.html: Reveal the attacker's occupied space to the target.
After the attack, the target may move 1 unit.
